go_hold.subject: Garden Planner as the candidate fourth business (blueprint only, no launch)
go_hold.rationale: Highest adjusted score in Scout run 2026-11-scout-01 and the only candidate with VERIFIED demand and price evidence that passes every gate. The changes: the free calculator must be the traffic engine, and the paid kit must do what free tools do not (a personal, printable season plan from one frost date).
go_hold.falsifying_test: If the free planting-calendar pages get 500+ organic or Pinterest sessions between 2027-01-01 and 2027-03-15 and the kit sells nothing, hold the niche. Owner-adjustable rule, not a forecast.

positioning.one_line: Home vegetable gardeners pay small amounts for printable planners and larger amounts for planning software; free date calculators are everywhere, so the opening is a personal frost-date planting calendar joined to a printable season planner, sold at about $15 before the January to March planning window.

desired_outcomes.statement: A season plan printed and on the fridge before seed-starting time, with nothing sown too early or too late.
